question:
Fill in the blank with the most suitable word.

The scientists ______ that the chefs relied on a specific motion.
solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 4'** i.e. **'Found'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The correct word to fill in the blank is **"found".**
 
• **Found:** This verb indicates the discovery or realization of something, which fits the context of the sentence.
